nodes.label: Symptom Catalog (21 pairs)
nodes.rationale: Two-tier shape keeps the symptom axis orthogonal to environmental context; carries vocabulary only, no weighting numbers (those are COMLab-owned).

nodes.label: LoadState (StrEnum)
nodes.rationale: Added as a third axis because manifold vacuum behaves inversely to throttle opening; closed throttle exposes vacuum leaks, open throttle exposes coil dielectric stress — diagnostic signal the thermal/temporal axes cannot carry.

nodes.label: will_not_start
nodes.rationale: Spelled-out enum value; the older wont_start label was reconciled to it in code.

nodes.label: SymptomDNA (Part-B payload)
nodes.rationale: Routing-free by design: states what the driver reported, never what to do about it. No mode-suppression/ranking/scoring fields — routing lives in COMLab downstream of the JSON boundary.

nodes.label: SymptomDNA.from_json
nodes.rationale: Validates field presence + axis-enum membership only, NOT catalog membership; that invariant is owned by validate(). Only for re-reading an already-validated payload.

nodes.label: revised 21-pair catalog
nodes.rationale: Two design moves: remove dimensional overlap (drop temperature/time sub-filters redundant with occurs_during), and add SAE-defined predictive complaints to fill discrimination gaps.

nodes.label: cold_engine_only (legacy, DROPPED)
nodes.rationale: Dropped — redundant with the occurs_during axis; removed to avoid multi-collinearity.

nodes.label: hot_engine_only (legacy, DROPPED)
nodes.rationale: Dropped — redundant with the occurs_during axis.

nodes.label: only_high_rpm_highway (legacy, DROPPED)
nodes.rationale: Dropped — better captured by the new load_state axis.

nodes.label: right_after_fillup (legacy, DROPPED)
nodes.rationale: Dropped — an environmental trigger not a physical symptom; overlaps EVAP purge mapping.

nodes.label: only_when_hot (legacy, DROPPED)
nodes.rationale: Dropped — redundant with the occurs_during axis.
